units.source_text: 源氏准备回六条院去探望三公主，而逡巡不前。

en.t: Genji was preparing to return to Rokujo-in to visit the Third Princess, but he hesitated and could not bring himself to go.

units.source_text: 但他想道：“皇上和朱雀院都关心她，

en.t: But then he thought, "Both the Emperor and Suzaku-in are concerned about her,

units.source_text: 况且我早就闻知她患恙，

en.t: and besides, I heard long ago that she was ill.

units.source_text: 过去只因眼前这个人病得厉害，

en.t: Until now, it was only because the person here before me was so gravely ill

units.source_text: 我心烦意乱，很久不曾到她那里住宿。

en.t: that my mind was in turmoil, and for a long time I have not gone to stay with her.

units.source_text: 现在这里已经云开见日，

en.t: Now that the clouds here have cleared and the sun has come out,

units.source_text: 我岂可再笼闭在这里呢？”

en.t: how could I remain shut up here any longer?"

units.source_text: 便下个决心，赴六条院去了。

en.t: So he made up his mind and went off to Rokujo-in.
